description: This source file contains extension methods for IServiceCollection to configure and add AdoNet grain storage support into an Orleans silo. It provides various overloads for setting up storage with options and default provider names.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainStorageServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: Static class containing extension methods for IServiceCollection to facilitate configuration and registration of AdoNet grain storage in Orleans.
